name: OrderGate for WooCommerce
author: ordergate

sections.description:
OrderGate for WooCommerce helps Bangladeshi sellers present the information buyers actually need, inside the product page their theme already renders. It never edits theme files and makes no external calls.

Setup wizard (Style A popup): pick product categories (one or many), pick a purpose (Promotion Campaign, Landing Page, New Product, Fix Product Page), then pick products — multi-select for promotion, single-select for a landing page.

Fashion template (v0.1): on the product edit screen — a size-guide template (পাঞ্জাবি বুকের মাপ 38/40/42/44, fully editable rows), exchange-policy selector, colour disclaimer toggle, and Dhaka inside/outside delivery-charge fields.

On the product page: variation dropdowns are enhanced into size buttons and colour swatches (the native WooCommerce variation form keeps working untouched), a size-guide table, a colour disclaimer note, an exchange-policy strip and a COD/delivery strip — only on products where the template is applied.

v0.1 implements the Fashion category fully. Other categories can be selected in the wizard and are honestly marked “শীঘ্রই আসছে” (coming soon).
sections.installation:
1. Upload the ordergate-for-woocommerce folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate it (WooCommerce must be active).
  3. Open the OrderGate menu in wp-admin and run the setup wizard.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin edit my theme?

No. The plugin never edits theme files. Its blocks render inside the standard WooCommerce product page using WooCommerce’s own hooks, so your theme’s layout stays exactly as it is.

Which product categories are supported?

Fashion is fully implemented in v0.1 (size-guide template, exchange policy, colour note, delivery charges). The other categories in the wizard (Beauty, Electronics, Food and more) are honestly marked “coming soon” and will arrive in later versions.

Does it work with any theme?

The blocks are placed in the generic WooCommerce product page, so they work with themes that use the standard WooCommerce single-product template flow. v0.1 is verified on Storefront and on the OrderGate flagship theme.

Does the plugin send data anywhere?

No. The plugin makes no external or remote calls. Everything is stored in your own WordPress database (options and product meta).

What happens on products where I don’t apply a template?

Nothing changes. A product with no OrderGate data renders as a completely native WooCommerce product page.
